papers.title: Risk of Stem Undersizing with Direct Anterior Approach for Total HIP Arthroplasty
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: The direct anterior approach (DAA) for total hip arthroplasty (THA) is claimed to be as effective but less invasive than the conventional posterior approach (PA). However, the higher risk of femoral fracture and soft tissue damage cannot be underestimated. The present authors believe that the difficult femoral exposure and the surgeon's knowledge of possible complications related to femoral preparation may result in a higher rate of undersized stems when compared to PA, even when a short femoral component is employed to minimise these risks. METHODS: A retrospective study was performed to compare the effective adherence of surgical sizing to preoperative planning in a series of 112 short stem THAs, of which 59 were implanted through PA and 53 through DAA without intraoperative imaging, by a single surgeon skilled in both techniques. RESULTS: the frequency of stems smaller than expected was 3-times higher with DAA than with PA (54.72% vs 16.95%, p<0.001), while the frequency of stems at least 2 sizes smaller than expected was more than 6-times higher with DAA than with PA (24.53% vs 3.39%, p = 0.001). Conversely, no differences of size discrepancy distribution were found for cups and prosthetic heads. Postoperative x-rays confirmed an inferior mean canal fill in the DAA group, but excluded a different incidence of frontal malalignment between the groups. CONCLUSIONS: The technical difficulty of femoral preparation and the surgeon's knowledge of possible related complications might lead to implant undersized stems more frequently through DAA than through PA, especially if intraoperative imaging controls are not used.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注手术入路对股骨柄尺寸选择的影响，不涉及力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress analysis, no micromotion or implant stability quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究直接前入路较后入路是否更容易导致股骨假体柄尺寸偏小。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析112例短柄全髋置换术，比较两种入路的假体尺寸偏差。
summary_zh.result: 直接前入路组假体柄尺寸偏小发生率显著高于后入路组。
summary_zh.validation: 基于术后X线片和手术记录的回顾性临床验证。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether the direct anterior approach increases the risk of femoral stem undersizing compared to the posterior approach in short-stem total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of 112 cases (59 posterior, 53 direct anterior) comparing actual stem sizes to preoperative templates, with statistical analysis of discrepancies.
summary_en.result: The direct anterior group had significantly higher rates of stem undersizing, including stems at least two sizes smaller (24.53% vs 3.39%).
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical validation using postoperative radiographs and surgical records.
